description: This file contains UI and logic components for handling pairing alerts in a macOS application, including window management, alert presentation, push task handling, and request approval/rejection mechanisms.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A custom NSWindow subclass that can become key and main window events are overridden.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: A class to hold the state of pairing alert, including the current alert, request ID, and associated window.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends an active alert, optionally for a specific application sheet.

methods.name: requireAlertHostWindow
methods.description: Ensures an alert host window exists; creates one if necessary.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Sets style and buttons of an NSAlert for pairing purposes.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Positions the alert window centered on the screen and presents it as a sheet.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Runs a background task to refresh gateway connection, load pending data, and handle push notifications.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Starts a pairing push notification task if not already running.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and presents a pairing alert sheet on a host window, activating the app.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert with a specific request ID, managing active alert state.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert<Request>
methods.description: Generic variant that handles a request context and invokes onResponse upon user decision.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears the active alert and request ID, and orders out the host window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompt, cancels tasks, and resets UI and state.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Attempts to perform an approval action, logs success or failure.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to perform a rejection action, logs success or failure.
